title: Conditional object spread
solution:
const isLoggedIn = true
const isAdmin = false
const user = {
  name: "Hariom",
  ...(isLoggedIn && { status: "active" }),
  ...(isAdmin && { role: "admin" }),
  ...(!isLoggedIn && { status: "inactive" })
}
return user
